answer.description: Required when status is answered. Plain text. May be null when refused.

refusal_reason.description: Required when status is refused. out_of_corpus = the tenant book does not contain the answer. not_permitted = it does, but not for this role.

refusal_message.description: Optional. What the user is shown when refused. Must not quote, paraphrase or name a document the role may not see.

citations.description: Required and non-empty when status is answered. Must be empty when refused.

section.description: The section heading as it appears in corpus/docs/<doc_id>.md

quote.description: A verbatim span from that document. Checked by exact match after normalization.

governing.description: Optional. When two or more documents bear on the answer and one controls, say which and why. The frontend must display this.

overridden.description: doc_ids that also bear on the question but do not control

superseded_notice.description: Optional. Set when any cited document has a newer version in the corpus, or was not in force on as_of.
